# Lantern maintenance

The beacon lantern on the north pier burns paraffin and is serviced
every ninety days by the keeper.

## Wicks

Trim the wick square, then round the corners slightly. A wick trimmed to a
point burns with a tall smoky flame and blackens the glass chimney.

## Glass

Wash the chimney in warm water with no soap. Soap leaves a film that
cracks when the glass heats. Dry it with a lint-free cloth.

## Fuel

Use clear paraffin only. Never top up a hot lantern; wait until the burner
has cooled for twenty minutes. Spilled fuel must be wiped before lighting.

## Logbook

Record the date, the fuel used in litres and the wick length in the keeper's
logbook after every service.
